page.overview:
Who is JJ?

JJ is a boy with a sleek pompadour and blue eyes. He wears a blue jacket with a white undershirt.

JJ is adept in taijutsu, being able to fight on an equal footing with Iwabee.

On the day of the entrance ceremony, as everyone began looking for an absent Boruto Uzumaki, he suddenly appeared, crashing a train into the Hokage Monument, which left JJ amazed at his antics.

Later, his class was assigned from Shino to shadow a non-shinobi workplace to better understand its lifestyle.
